scope: Unverified summary of the headline national rules for a visiting hobby pilot. Commercial filming, local by-laws and site permissions are not covered.

registrationRequired.note: KCAA registration and an operator permit are required; foreigners must import with KCAA approval.

pilotCertRequired.note: A remote pilot licence is required.

altitudeNote: General ceiling for hobby flights; lower limits apply near aerodromes and in restricted zones.
maxDistanceRule: Visual line of sight at all times.

importRestriction.note: Import needs prior KCAA approval; customs holds drones without it.

noFlyHighlights: National parks and reserves (KWS permit required)

cityNotes.note: KWS and conservancy permits are required and rarely granted to tourists.
Registration and a permit for any city flight.

notes: Written from general knowledge on 2026-09-19 without fetching the sources; not verified. Confirm on the authority page before flying.
